commands.name: openWindow
commands.summary: Show an existing window by its type name.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: Case-insensitive type name of an existing WindowManager window; does not create a new instance.

arguments.name: section
arguments.description: SettingsWindow category, case-insensitive: Interface, Theme, Projects, Audio, Midi, InputDevices, Keyboard, Diagnostics. Other windows ignore it. Current Enum.TryParse also accepts numeric strings; no defined-value validation is promised.

commands.result: Object {window:string} with the actual type name.
commands.effects: Sets window visibility before checking settings category. INVALID_PARAM can therefore still make the window visible. Window layout/settings may persist.
commands.completion: Immediate state assignment; drawing occurs on a frame.

commands.name: getGraphView
commands.summary: Read the focused graph canvas's target scope.
commands.result: Object with scale,scrollX,scrollY,visibleArea:{minX,minY,maxX,maxY},windowX,windowY,windowWidth,windowHeight. Describes target scope, not necessarily the currently drawn interpolated scope.
commands.effects: Reads existing canvas; does not create a view.

commands.name: setGraphView
commands.summary: Set or adjust the focused graph canvas.

arguments.name: area
arguments.description: If an object, takes precedence over all center/scale/relative fields. Missing components are zero; max must exceed min on both axes.

arguments.name: centerX
arguments.description: Absolute canvas center X before relative scrolling.

arguments.name: centerY
arguments.description: Absolute canvas center Y before relative scrolling.

arguments.name: scale
arguments.description: Absolute scale before zoomBy. Resulting scale must be greater than 0.001 and at most 100; NaN is rejected. Center/scroll finiteness has no corresponding explicit check.

arguments.name: scrollByX
arguments.description: Add to selected center X in canvas units.

arguments.name: scrollByY
arguments.description: Add to selected center Y in canvas units.

arguments.name: smooth
arguments.description: Use target interpolation rather than an instant scope change.

commands.result: Object with scale,scrollX,scrollY,visibleArea:{minX,minY,maxX,maxY},windowX,windowY,windowWidth,windowHeight. Describes target scope, not necessarily the currently drawn interpolated scope. Area branch instead returns {appliesNextFrame:true}.
commands.effects: Changes graph view only. Area fitting is queued until the canvas knows its current window size.
commands.completion: Area fitting applies on a later frame; non-area response describes the assigned target.

commands.name: focusGraphView
commands.summary: Frame specified children, the selection, or the whole graph.

arguments.name: childIds
arguments.description: Explicit children take precedence over all. Missing-symbol stand-ins explicitly named here are included regardless of includeMissing. Invalid GUID gives INVALID_PARAM; absent child gives NOT_FOUND.
arguments.omissionBehavior: Use selection; if empty, all graph children.

arguments.name: all
arguments.description: Without childIds, clears selection before computing bounds. Ignored when childIds is an array.

arguments.name: padding
arguments.description: Expand bounds by canvas units. Negative values are not explicitly rejected.

arguments.name: smooth
arguments.description: Choose smooth rather than instant fitting.

commands.result: Object {appliesNextFrame:true,area:{minX,minY,maxX,maxY}} describes requested bounds including padding.
commands.effects: Queues canvas fitting; all:true can clear selection even if there is nothing to focus.
commands.completion: Fit is applied on a later canvas frame; pump and read getGraphView to inspect its result.

commands.name: pin
commands.summary: Pin an existing focused-composition child in the primary visible output window.

arguments.name: childId
arguments.description: Child must be an instance in the focused composition.

commands.effects: Changes output pinning and may cause operator evaluation/rendering on subsequent frames.
commands.completion: Immediate pin assignment; inspect getContext and allow frames for output.

commands.name: outputSetup
commands.summary: Enter output-setup view and optionally choose an entity and edit mode.

arguments.name: entity
arguments.description: Exact case-sensitive entity name, first match in existing setup search order. Does not enumerate entities.

arguments.name: mode
arguments.description: Case-insensitive edit-mode name: Board, Straight or Output. Current Enum.TryParse also accepts numeric strings; unsupported numeric values have no validated meaning.

commands.effects: Requires an active setup. Sets setup view before validating entity/mode; a failed mode can leave view and entity selection changed.
commands.completion: Immediate state assignment; visible effect follows drawing.

commands.name: resetView
commands.summary: Reset the primary visible output window's view camera.
commands.effects: Changes existing camera/view state; does not reset graph canvas, pinning or project data.
commands.completion: Immediate reset request; next output frame reflects camera state.

commands.name: layoutSelection
commands.summary: Arrange inputs of the current graph selection.
commands.result: Object {changed:boolean,selectedIds:GUID string array}. changed means something moved or selection grew; false can mean empty selection, no applicable work or active interaction.
commands.effects: Moves graph nodes through existing undoable layout commands and can expand selection upstream. Connections are preserved; saved layout can change.
commands.completion: Immediate operation using the cached graph UI layout. Known current limitation: bridge add/connect can leave this cache stale even after frames; layout then reports changed:false. A validated undo/redo of the last graph edit rebuilds the view, after which layout works. Do not silently replay arbitrary edits as a general refresh strategy.
